scope: Manually authored Russian targets for source-backed review. Not automatically imported into the mod;variable shapes,styles and runtime reachability still require dedicated acceptance tests. Alpha/archival status is attached from full source,not guessed from wording.

records.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: Sike
records.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: Попался!

records.source: [NPC] Calvin: Hey, you're a familiar face!
records.translation: [NPC] Calvin: О, знакомое лицо!

records.source: [NPC] Calvin: I don't have any Returning Player Rewards for you right now. Thanks for playing SkyBlock!
records.translation: [NPC] Calvin: Сейчас у меня нет для тебя наград за возвращение. Спасибо, что играешь в SkyBlock!

records.source: [NPC] Ghost of Game Agent: I need something to pass the time while I wait to be reincarnated.
records.translation: [NPC] Ghost of Game Agent: Нужно чем-то заняться, пока я жду перерождения.

records.source: [NPC] Ghost of Game Agent: Well hopefully I can't bore myself to death given the fact I'm already dead!
records.translation: [NPC] Ghost of Game Agent: Что ж, надеюсь, от скуки я не умру — я ведь уже мёртв!

records.source: [NPC] Ghost of Warren: Curse your investments!
records.translation: [NPC] Ghost of Warren: Будь прокляты твои вложения!

records.source: [NPC] Ghost of Warren: Even in death I am obsessed with the prospect of something that just keeps growing, and growing, and growing.
records.translation: [NPC] Ghost of Warren: Даже после смерти меня не отпускает мысль о том, что может расти, расти и расти без конца.

records.source: [NPC] Ghost of Warren: These look promising, thanks!
records.translation: [NPC] Ghost of Warren: Выглядит многообещающе, спасибо!

records.source: [NPC] Pesthunter Pamela: Hi! I want to reforge my Peony Bracelet to Blooming. Would you happen to have a Flowering Bouquet?
records.translation: [NPC] Pesthunter Pamela: Привет! Хочу наложить на свой браслет пиона перековку «Цветущий». У тебя случайно нет цветущего букета?

records.source: [NPC] Sam: I hope you aren't denying too many Visitors...
records.translation: [NPC] Sam: Надеюсь, ты не слишком часто отказываешь посетителям...

records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Amateurism at its finest!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Верх дилетантства!

records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: I see...
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Понятно...

records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Oh my!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Вот это да!

records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Still... progress.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: И всё же... прогресс.

records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: We are only a few more terrible ideas away from success.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Ещё несколько ужасных идей — и нас ждёт успех.

records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Well well well.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Так-так-так.

records.source: [NPC] Ryan: A Campfire Initiate Badge I, for our latest initiate, <username>!
records.translation: [NPC] Ryan: Значок посвящённого костра I — нашему новому посвящённому, <username>!
records.runtime_constraint: Preserve actual username and observed player-head component without expanding the global username guard.

records.source: [NPC] Ryan: Congrats! Your <old badge item name> was upgraded to a <new badge item name>!
records.translation: [NPC] Ryan: Поздравляю! Значок улучшен: <old badge item name> → <new badge item name>!
records.runtime_constraint: Closed known badge names/tiers only;do not accept arbitrary item or player text.

records.source: [NPC] Ryan: I need you to hold your <badge item name> so I can upgrade it!
records.translation: [NPC] Ryan: Возьми в руку «<badge item name>», чтобы я мог улучшить значок!
records.runtime_constraint: Copy current component and styles of the closed known badge name.

records.source: [NPC] Ryan: Next step is the Trial of Fire <tier>! (<amount> damage)
records.translation: [NPC] Ryan: Следующее испытание огня — <tier>! (<amount> урона)
records.runtime_constraint: Validate Roman tier and bounded numeric damage separately;preserve both current components.

records.source: [NPC] Ryan: Try the Trial of Fire Trial <tier> for a greater challenge!
records.translation: [NPC] Ryan: Попробуй испытание огня <tier>, если хочешь задачу посложнее!
records.runtime_constraint: Closed valid published Trial of Fire tiers only.

records.source: [NPC] Ryan: Y'know, someone as stealthy as you could be a useful member of the Campfire Cult.
records.translation: [NPC] Ryan: Знаешь, такой скрытный, как ты, мог бы пригодиться Культу костра.

records.source: Collect Spruce Logs
records.translation: Соберите еловые брёвна
records.runtime_constraint: Preserve live counter and its styles;do not enumerate every progress value or cache them without bounds.

records.source: Collect Dark Oak Logs
records.translation: Соберите брёвна тёмного дуба
records.runtime_constraint: Preserve live counter and its styles;do not enumerate every progress value or cache them without bounds.

records.source: Find the Campfire
records.translation: Найдите костёр

records.source: Travel to the Savanna Woodland
records.translation: Отправляйтесь в саванну

records.source: You claimed a Campfire Initiate Badge I!
records.translation: Вы получили значок посвящённого костра I!
